name: 舞动路路
evolution: 呆小路 Lv.26 → 舞动路路 → 白发路路 Lv.40
description: 每只舞动路路都携带着一颗蛋，经常看到它们用头上的毛发擦拭蛋，那是它们最珍视的一部分。蓬松的毛发下看不到眼睛，主要靠头上的叶片来感受环境，身体非常灵活。
descriptionEn: Each Wudonglulu carries an egg, often seen wiping it with the hair on its head; that is the part they treasure most. Under the fluffy fur no eyes are visible; it mainly senses the environment through the leaf on its head, and its body is very flexible.
